verdict.rationale: Docs describe a tool-calling API (register a tool, SDK owns call-and-execute loop and detects model format) but there is no mention of reasoning-parser support anywhere in the pack, and hands-on community reports show tool-calling actually failing in practice — a voice command reported success ('I navigated to google.com') when no action executed, which the maintainers acknowledged as a known limitation of small models conflating intent with execution. missing for 10: reasoning-parser support evidence, serving-api-level (not just SDK-level) tool-calling docs, and a hands-on success case to counterbalance the documented failure.
